facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a greatsword, was left incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may rise and attack the party if they return.
If Sir Alfred recovers, he may kill more Free Goblin Society members, who are now settling the Barrow Mound's upper level behind a wall over the stairs.
Why does Sir Alfred, a huge undead knight with a greatsword whom Brother Dirk regards as holy, roam the Barrow Mound?
